why: This is a professionalism-specific application of Multiple Methods of Assessment: an SJT is useful only when it adds independent information beyond existing academic and cognitive measures, with content and cognitive load designed to avoid redundancy.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns one SJT's incremental predictive validity, not whether combining multiple assessment methods yields a more accurate judgement.
The finding concerns the predictive validity of a single admissions SJT, not whether combining multiple assessment methods improves assessment accuracy.
The study concerns the incremental predictive validity of one SJT score beyond academic and cognitive measures, not whether using multiple assessment methods yields a more accurate judgement.
